title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E01 — Welcome to the Lake
The Fourth of July at the Lake of the Ozarks begins as Chief Boren and officers confront an unruly bar patron; Officer Kale Keagy stops a suspected drunken driver on the highway.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E06 — Shootout Boat Races
As cigarette boats battle for speed supremacy on the lake, Chief Boren and Officers Glascock and Khachi meet a bar patron who insists she's done nothing wrong; Officer Jonathan Rosenburg confronts revelers on a party boat.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E03 — Refusal to Comply
Summer at the Lake of the Ozarks heats up as Cpl. Stephen Riner investigates a road rage case; K9 officer Cpl. Caleb Harvey and his dog Donzi search a vehicle suspected of carrying drugs.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E04 — Hot Summer Night
The Hot Summer Nights classic car show rolls into town for a day of fun, but things turn really hot that night when there is an outbreak of bar fights; Officer Rosenberg picks up a pair of underage shoplifters and gives them a valuable life lesson.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E05 — Fight on the Strip
Corp. Caleb Harvey stops a driver he suspects has meth; Officer Karl Glascock must rescue a young man who has driven a car into a ditch to avoid deer; Corp. Stephen Riner arrests a grandmother whose record prohibits her from driving.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E10 — End of Watch
The Lake Ozark and Osage Beach Police Departments must confront an unspeakable tragedy when one of their officers tragically dies in the line of duty.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E07 — Disturbance in Progress
As summer rolls on, the police officers try to keep the Lake of the Ozarks community safe; Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula gets called to the aid of a bloodied and concussed bar patron lying in the road.

description:
S08 E09 — Episode 9
Emotions run high as a grieving daughter confronts her father's killer in court; the judge questions a woman accused of falsely reporting her boyfriend for domestic battery; a judge catches a defendant lying in court and sends her to jail; and more.

title: Court Cam
description:
S08 E23 — Episode 23
A woman accused of not paying her rent bursts into her landlord's office; a judge clears the courtroom after holding a defense attorney in contempt; the judge admonishes a defendant for leaving his computer during a virtual hearing; more.

title: Court Cam
description:
S08 E24 — Episode 24
A convicted drug dealer makes a daring courthouse escape after sentencing; a woman convicted of Felony D.U.I. and Reckless Homicide makes an emotional courtroom apology to the victim's family; and more.

title: Court Cam
description:

title: Court Cam
description:

title: Court Cam
description:

title: Court Cam
description:

description:

description:
